These assignments are swaps (with occasional direct overwrites), so the final values can be computed by running the sequence in R and then printing the variables:

```r
cat(sprintf(
  "ANSWER: a ?= %s; b ?= %s; c ?= %s; d ?= %s; TMP ?= %s;\n",
  a, b, c, d, TMP
))
```

Run this immediately after the assignments to get the requested final line.
